title: Front St West bus lay-by (2025): new shelter and relocated accessible loading zone for the 114 and 121
body: City Council item 2025.EX21.4 (Transit Priority on Queens Quay East)
status: approved; shelter not yet listed in City data
status_note: The report proposes a new bus stop marker and shelter at the east end of the Front St West lay-by, and moves the Wheel-Trans accessible loading zone 50 m east with a dropped curb and curb ramp. The new stop appears in the TTC schedule, but the City's shelter list does not show a shelter there yet.
quotes: A new bus stop marker and bus shelter would be introduced at the east end of the lay-by area to indicate customer pick-up, for the TTC's 114 Queens Quay East and 121 Esplanade-River routes.
Following consultation with Wheel-Trans, the existing accessible loading zone is proposed to be relocated 50 metres east from its current location, to in front of the marked bus layover area.
